account: In a September 2026 post, Citizens Advice SORT’s Stuart Pearson describes a January panel that considered three proposals for public-facing Caddy and proposed a fourth. Residents called for client choice, human escalation for red flags, and transparency. They also noted that members of the public would lack trained advisers’ prompting skills. A separate Open University interview describes an earlier presentation in July 2024. The council’s LGA account reports learning and confidence changes from its wider participation program, not improved outcomes from Caddy. None of these accounts establishes deployment of the proposed public service or a benefit to its clients.

ai_role.statement: Caddy would support public-facing advice. The panel generated the design recommendations; the intended AI contribution to advice outcomes has not been evaluated.

fields.account: In a September 2026 post, Citizens Advice SORT’s Stuart Pearson describes a January panel that considered three proposals for public-facing Caddy and proposed a fourth. Residents called for client choice, human escalation for red flags, and transparency. They also noted that members of the public would lack trained advisers’ prompting skills. A separate Open University interview describes an earlier presentation in July 2024. The council’s LGA account reports learning and confidence changes from its wider participation program, not improved outcomes from Caddy. None of these accounts establishes deployment of the proposed public service or a benefit to its clients.
